LanguageData.RHA_StarCharge030_Brief: Charged barrage: focus fire on the glowing guard, stun it, or leave the marked corridor. A damage interrupt briefly staggers the guard. In guard-break trials, a damage or stun interrupt by your expedition also silences the core for 3 seconds and cancels its pending ground strike. Other guards and shots already in flight remain dangerous.
LanguageData.RHA_StarCharge030_Recovery: Core disrupted: {0}s · press the attack on its guards
